name: jaxfdm_creased_shell
source_ref: examples/creased_shell/creased_shell.py (data/json/creased_shell.json; the same structure appeared earlier as examples/butt, examples/vault and examples/creased_vault) (commit 9a17fd379071fb3511ca914f46e8d1e8c286460e)
description: A creased compression shell network (193 nodes, 37 leaf supports) under uniform vertical loads. The original example is a best-fit problem: it drives every free node onto the designer's target surface stored in the input JSON (kept here as target_original).

original_run.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH
original_run.notes: RootMeanSquaredError(NodePointGoal on every free node -> target_original).

position_fit_run.optimizer: jax_fdm.optimization.LBFGSB (scipy.optimize.minimize method='L-BFGS-B', tol=1e-10 -> ftol=gtol=1e-10, maxiter=1000, maxfun/maxls/maxcor = scipy defaults 15000/20/10, jac from jax.value_and_grad, jit)
position_fit_run.message: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT
position_fit_run.notes: NodePointGoal on every free node (weight 1) with SquaredError -> loss = sum of squared distances to `target`; final_err = sqrt(loss) recomputed with an independent NumPy FDM solve at q_final. loss_trace[k] is the loss at the k-th SciPy callback (index 0 = q0). time_s includes the JIT compile/warm-up done by Optimizer.problem(); time_s_excl_jit is the SciPy solve only.
